For an affected root Content.* project use [Modules/CATALOG](../../Modules/CATALOG.md) and its linked owner guide. [Architecture](../../.agents/rules/architecture-and-ownership.md) owns dependencies; inspect a manifest only if the owner has one. In review assess the changed reference/owner contract; do not bootstrap every project.
